description: Immutable identifier for the reused archived conditional taxonomy layer
Locked independent Monte Carlo seed blocks used once for the combined MC and stress confirmation layer
One predeclared family-by-engine condition profile per row
Each metric is assessed separately; their joint status is reported as a descriptive Pareto label and never used as an eligibility filter
Stress reuses seeds 21-26 and is not represented as a second independent held-out panel
Every locked family-engine profile is carried into real-world scoring regardless of its prior metric-specific evidence
